req.title: Basic-auth rejects wrong password
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 401 and WWW-Authenticate: Basic when Basic-auth credentials are missing or wrong.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> must return HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Basic when credentials are missing or wrong, and HTTP 200 with authenticated payload when correct. Tests cover: (1) positive EP – correct credentials yield 200 + JSON payload; (2) negative EP – wrong password yields 401 + WWW-Authenticate header; (3) negative EP – missing Authorization header yields 401; (4) DT – correct user but wrong password (boolean short-circuit on password check); (5) BVA – empty string credentials vs non-empty; (6) NEG – wrong username with correct password. Each assertion is exact-value to kill constant, comparison, and boolean mutations.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200_with_payload
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/myuser/mypass with correct Basic auth header
expected: JSON body contains authenticated=true and user='myuser'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-019: Expected outcomes: HTTP 2xx response with expected payload
core.py basic_auth: returns jsonify(authenticated=True, user=user) on success
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

credentials = base64.b64encode(b'myuser:mypass').decode('utf-8')
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {credentials}'}

def test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200_with_payload():
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/myuser/mypass', headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'myuser'

from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_basic_auth_wrong_password_returns_401_with_www_authenticate():
    credentials = base64.b64encode(b'myuser:WRONGPASS').decode('utf-8')
    headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {credentials}'}
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/myuser/mypass', headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 401

    assert www_auth.startswith('Basic')

tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_basic_auth_status_code_is_not_200_on_wrong_creds():
    credentials = base64.b64encode(b'user:WRONG').decode('utf-8')
    headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {credentials}'}
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/user/pass', headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 401
    assert r.status_code != 400
    assert r.status_code != 403
    assert r.status_code != 200
